title: Sunset Pointe 30A | KEY.co
description_expanded: Sunset Pointe is a stunning Dune Allen Beach retreat that combines modern elegance with serene coastal charm. Built in 2022, this thoughtfully designed home and carriage house offer breathtaking Gulf and lake views, visible from three expansive patios and a spectacular fourth-floor terrace. With vaulted ceilings, designer finishes, and a soothing coastal color palette, every space radiates comfort and sophistication. The state-of-the-art kitchen, equipped with Sonos Audio, flows effortlessly into family-friendly living areas, each featuring smart TVs and entertainment options. Outdoors, a private heated pool, spa, fire pit, and al fresco dining area create the perfect setting for relaxation and connection under the Florida sun. Set in the tranquil Dune Allen Beach community, this home provides a peaceful retreat while being just a short drive to the shops and restaurants of Gulf Place. Surrounded by miles of trails, five coastal dune lakes, and pristine beaches, it’s a paradise for nature lovers and those seeking a laid-back escape. With spacious living areas, three family rooms for evening games, and conveniences like a washer and dryer on each floor, Sunset Pointe ensures a seamless and memorable beachside experience for families and friends.
